verificationRecords.scope: s02 promotion inventory and canonical-versus-compatibility ownership
verificationRecords.notes: Nineteen focused checks pass; the inventory freezes five non-interchangeable evidence stages, confirms only numerator split/merge currently has canonical fraction paint, and confirms the composition trace has no route or paint owner. Type and architecture gates pass.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:fraction-composition-architecture; npm run typecheck; npm run check:architecture
verificationRecords.scope: s03 exact trace, dependencies, fold, paint, layout, and architecture preservation manifest
verificationRecords.notes: Twenty-three focused checks pass. All 14 states retain exact solution 9, all 13 adjacent transitions have authority and acyclic dependencies, and the frozen product boundary requires one clock/session/lease with native settlement and no operation geometry.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:fraction-composition-architecture; npm run typecheck; npm run check:architecture
verificationRecords.notes: Twenty-three focused checks pass. The semantic constructor now mints an unforgeable proof for complete quotient fan-out, preserves numerator and denominator identity/value, and rejects denominator drift before paint code can consume the transform. Type and architecture gates pass.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:fraction-composition-architecture; npm run typecheck; npm run check:architecture
verificationRecords.scope: s05 constructor-only numerator-normalization and distributed-sum composition certificates
verificationRecords.notes: Twenty-three focused checks pass. Both schedule policies are proven to consume the same ordered normalized branches, and composition proof preserves branch identity/order while transitively carrying fan-out and normalization evidence. Negative type fixtures prevent fabrication.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:fraction-composition-architecture; npm run typecheck; npm run check:architecture
verificationRecords.scope: s06 inverse factoring and exact solve trace certificates
verificationRecords.notes: Twenty-three focused checks pass. Reverse factoring proof can only be minted through successful forward redistribution, and the macro now carries an unforgeable transitive certificate for 14 exact-solution states, 13 authority-backed adjacent steps, composition, and inverse factoring. Type and architecture gates pass.

progress.summary: Approved for canonical learner promotion through the exact 20-slice contract; implementation not yet started.

expectedLearning: Whether an accepted renderer-neutral fraction composition trace can reach a canonical learner reader mostly through verified content, motif, fold, layout, descriptor, and product wiring without protected-core growth.
Whether proof-carrying maturity evidence can prevent a semantic or compatibility animation from being falsely reported as a human-reviewed canonical port.
allowedWork: The approved canonical 2/3(x+6)=10 promotion proposal, its existing semantic trace, bounded type ratchets, one reader route and library registration, stable verification, and durable evidence.
disallowedWork: No family rollout, exact quantity models, protected compositor expansion, second runtime or clock, operation-specific geometry, or user-owned dirty files.
